title: Nervous breakdown, quitting Dizzy and the club owner at knifepoint
summary: Sam's stomach trouble is tied by doctors to the band; in Miami Beach Dizzy pulls a switchblade on a complaining club owner.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: And so, I had a nervous breakdown, them bands was getting to me man, ---my nerves, it got so bad my uhm, stomach was like in balls, you know.

You know, took sick, uhm, trying to find out what the devil that was, went to plenty of doctors, and uhm, so my doctor kept collaborating with a psychiatrist, and uhm, and they found out, that uh, that the band I'm working in was causing me to be ill, and uhm so I had to quit.

And my doctors called Dizzy and told him and boy, he jumped up sky high man, and we was getting ready to go to Florida, down in Miami Beach, so he told him, he say, 'Well, uh, if I take it easy, what if I take it easy on him and uh, we going down to Florida and the sunshine, the sunshine might do him some good'. So the doctor say, 'Well,' he thought about that for a minute and he say, 'well, well if he take it easy on him and uhm, you know, the sun might do him some good, I don't know, but you know, if you get down there.' So he say, 'Well I promise you doctor I'll be, and that sucker boy he took me down to Florida man, and it was just like any other of them fast tempos,, just took me right through all them changes, you know, I had to go through all of them. I ignored the thing and when I heard, uh, Dizzy had a way of relaxing, coming back on uh, after he had intermission, he take a long intermission, so , so the club owner, was, you know, looking at King through the dressing room, and I was sitting there, I wasn't feeling, my stomach was hurting again, and I'm sitting there. Oh man, he went wild on me,
and uh, this was uh, the second band he had, this band was.
"Where is Dizzy? I didn't have him to come down here to have ya'll to sit around"-----this is the club owner, you know.

Oh man, he went crazy on us, it was his club man, don't tell us that, go tell him that you know, we work for him, he's the band leader, don't tell me that so, "I will tell him that" so when Dizzy came, we started saying man, the club owner's looking for you, and he's going crazy telling about, telling us about he didn't have us to come down there and Dizzy say "He say what?" and that crazy dude took his switch blade knife and we knew a thing man, he had the club owner up against the wall man, with this knife.
See, and boy,my nerves are really out then.
